name: Gate Keeper
summary: Shows who fail2ban has banned on this server, and why, on its own page and a Home card.
description: Gate Keeper lists every address fail2ban has banned on your server: the jail that banned it, when, and until when (or permanently), plus how many new bans came in the last hour and 24 hours. Studio Home shows a card with the counts and the busiest jails; the addresses stay on the app's page. It is read-only: it reads through the security:read permission, which gives no firewall, socket or shell access and cannot unban anything.

application.description: Shows who fail2ban has banned on this server, and why, on its own page and a Home card.

arguments: python -m py_compile main.py gate.py && mkdir -p dist/ui && cp main.py gate.py index.html gate.js gate.css dist/ && cp ui/app.css ui/app.js dist/ui/
